title: DNMT3L Neuron code for fetal Down syndrome methylation concordance
description: Reproducibility code for the Brief Report on fetal Down syndrome methylation concordance. Version 1.2.0 analyzes donor-level direction odds ratios, matched CpG panels and a DNMT3A W330R fibroblast comparator.
